archetype: four-storey mixed-use city block with four businesses, separate residential access and twelve apartments
commercial_program: diner with street seating, service counter, kitchen, cold store and wash station
pharmacy with sales floor, dispensing counter, medicine shelves and secured rear stock
hardware and repair shop with display aisles, workbench, parts storage and receiving
laundromat with customer machines, folding counter, utility room and supply store
separate rear delivery doors and two controlled service thresholds for every business
residential_program: independent street lobby with mail banks, duty desk and radio point
three apartment floors with four independently accessible corner dwellings per floor
living, cooking, bedroom and bathroom functions in every apartment
cross-corridor connecting every apartment to front and rear stairs
stacked street balconies and repeated windows communicating residential density
enclosed rooftop mechanical plant reached from the rear stair
damage_constraints: confine the primary collapse to the southeast laundromat and apartment stack
preserve the diner, pharmacy, lobby and functional front portion of the hardware shop
preserve three complete apartments on every residential floor
preserve both stair stacks and the central cross-corridor
direct gravity-led rubble toward the rear alley
derive damage, occupation and loot only from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: all four businesses read as different real premises rather than repeated rooms
the residential lobby is visibly separate from every storefront
all twelve apartments have legible domestic programs and usable private-room thresholds
both stair stacks and the roof plant work at player scale
the southeast collapse follows floor stacking and gravity rather than random deletion
terrain feathering seats storefronts, rear deliveries and rubble into city grade
